**Known hazards for future sprints:**
- Model the exact previous production schema in every migration fixture; target-schema columns can hide upgrade failures.
- Audit store row mappers whenever schema writes add or restore fields.
- Assert constraints, indexes, and foreign-key actions after table-rebuild migrations.
